### I did more testing after this video and I found a bit more things
- GSQ-RCO quants do surprisingly well at q5 or q4 KV cache. Worth noting if you are VERY desperate (Damage is still bad but is not unusable)
- Not a fan of finetunes that "Increases speeds" by reducing thinking tokens. They perform worse at xhigh thinking in real tasks. I would much rather just set the thinking level to low if I want to "Increase speeds"
- Bonsai vastly outperforms Unsloth for knowledge. Still unusable for Agentic coding.

I will do perplexity/KLD benchmarks next time. I wanted to do more but I don't want to delay the video any longer esp with Qwen 4 this month
